mapper.select: SELECT d.*, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ps.dog_personal_gbn_cd ORDER BY ps.dog_personal_gbn_cd SEPARATOR ',') FROM tbl_dog_personal ps WHERE ps.dog_id = d.dog_id) AS dogPersonalGbnCds, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pl.dog_play_gbn_cd ORDER BY pl.dog_play_gbn_cd SEPARATOR ',') FROM tbl_dog_play pl WHERE pl.dog_id = d.dog_id) AS dogPlayGbnCds FROM tbl_likes l JOIN tbl_dogs d ON d.dog_id = l.dog_id WHERE l.my_dog_id = #{myDogId} AND like_code = #{likeCode}
